reviewed_by: Codex review of October 13 release real-Core traces and current compact navigation
reason: The release's production Core journeys wait for a status chip hidden in the compact Workbench, try to switch projects before opening the navigation lens, or expect a Code tab before opening any file. The selected subagent fixture also races a generated title update when saving its permission, so it retries only revision conflicts against Core's latest value. Select the three affected project/Code journeys and the assistant pairing journeys on desktop and 390 px Chromium/WebKit to prove pairing, selection, file use, and reload on a production LAN Core.
exclusions: This changes focused real-Core acceptance assertions only. Python, frontend component, native, mocked-browser and unrelated real-Core cases are excluded. Mobile browsers are emulated; no physical device is available. No full suite is authorized.
